Important Dates

Here's the full schedule for Perpetual Alpha, from registration to the award ceremony at ICAIF 2026 in Milan.

Date Phase Description
Sep 20 Registration Deadline Team registration closes.
Sep 21 – Oct 4 Onboarding Wallet whitelisting, testnet funding, and tutorial notebooks.
Oct 5 – Oct 18 Practice All markets go live for teams to test connectivity and strategies. (Non-scored)
Oct 19 – Nov 6 Live Trading Three weeks of continuous trading. (Scored)
Nov 9 Submission Deadline Deadline to submit technical reports (2–4 pages) and code.
Nov 9 – Nov 12 Jury Evaluation Code walkthroughs, final score computation, and finalist notifications.
Nov 14 – Nov 17 ICAIF 2026 (Milan) Competition Track: top-team presentations, results, and award ceremony.
